{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness host plugin that keeps project documents and long-term memory as plain Markdown in a dedicated Obsidian vault.","id":"gh:1384702916","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-obsidian-mem","slug":"bonerush/dsh-obsidian-mem","topics":["agent-memory","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","fts5","markdown","obsidian","project-memory"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness host plugin that keeps project documents and long-term memory as plain Markdown in "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"a dedicated Obsidian vault."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-obsidian-mem"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Project memory and a knowledge graph for DeepSeek Harness — plain Markdown in an Obsidian vault"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English · 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A **DeepSeek Harness host plugin** that keeps a project's documents and long-term
memory as plain Ma"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"rkdown in a dedicated Obsidian vault, and
draws that memory in the native sidebar: a GitHub-style co"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ntribution calendar, a
day-grouped activity timeline, searchable notes with highlighted snippets, an"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"d a
force-directed knowledge graph."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"One repository gets one stable `projectId`, one committed pointer file and one
fixed directory in th"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"e vault. The plugin writes there; Obsidian just shows you
the result. Obsidian does not need to be r"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"unning, and no part of the vault
depends on DSH."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Two layers, on purpose:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Protocol** (vault layout, the `.obsidian-mem` pointer, note frontmatter, the
distillation output"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" contract) is plain Markdown and is not DSH-specific. The
shipped skill `skills/obsidian-mem/SKILL.m"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"d` follows the Agent Skills format,
so it works in another harness too — `codex/` installs that
prot"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ocol *and* the same six operations into Codex CLI, through an MCP server that
reuses `lib/` rather t"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"han copying it, plus hooks for the session brief and a
small relevant-note map on each new user prom"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"pt.
- **Adapter** is DSH-specific: six `mem_*` tools, a `node:sqlite` search index kept
outside the "},{"id":"p9s7","text":"vault, and automatic distillation of completed turns. The recall
injection left that list: both harn"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"esses compose it from the same `buildBrief`,
and each delivers it through its own extension point."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> **Read Honest limits before you enable automatic writes.**
> This plugin is careful about what it "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"refuses, but it is young. What follows is
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| | Version | Why |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Node | `>= 22.22.2` | The floor is a *measurement*. `node:sqlite` imports on Node 22.13.0, but tha"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"t build has no FTS5; 22.22.2 and 25.9.0 do. Versions 22.14–22.21 were not tested, so the floor is th"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"e lowest version actually proven to work. |
| DSH | `>= 0.1.5-rc.2` | The floor declared as `engines"},{"id":"p13s4","text":".dsh`. Supported on the current release (`0.2.1-rc.5`) and on every version between it and the floor"},{"id":"p13s5","text":": each intermediate release has been surveyed against the row `config:` and the documented Cordis se"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"ams this plugin actually uses, and none was found incompatible. |
| Obsidian | any recent version | "},{"id":"p13s7","text":"Optional. Only needed to *read* the vault comfortably. |
| OS | Windows, macOS, Linux | All three ar"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"e supported. The plugin is portable Node code, the sidebar panel is a web view, and there is no nati"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"ve module to compile. CI runs the same `npm run check` gate on Linux and Windows; macOS has no separ"},{"id":"p13s10","text":"ate CI leg, but it takes the same portable path. One named constraint is part of the support level: "},{"id":"p13s11","text":"curation review relies on `O_NOFOLLOW`, so it remains a macOS/Linux workflow on Windows — the exact "},{"id":"p13s12","text":"refusal is under **Failure recovery** below, and reads, writes and scans are unaffected. |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Runtime dependencies are deliberately tiny: `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` for config
validation and `ya"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ml` for frontmatter. `node:sqlite` is built into Node, so there
is no native module to compile."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The DSH floor is declared where the ecosystem declares it — `engines.dsh` in
`package.json`, with th"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e same range in `dsh.plugin.json`. Measured: nothing in an
installed harness reads that key (a searc"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"h for `engines.dsh` across every installed
`@deepseek-ai/*` package returns nothing), so it is a dec"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"laration for registry and
market tooling, not a gate DSH enforces."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"#### 概览 — five charts"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**概览** opens on five charts: a GitHub-style contribution calendar of the trailing 53
weeks (371 days"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"; fixed 10×10 px cells on a 2 px gap, month labels above the columns and
a sticky 一/三/五 weekday gutt"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"er) whose numbers live in the section head
(`近 N 周（371 天）· 本周 N 天有更新 · 合计 M 条`) because a square is "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"a shape and not a
reading. The calendar scrolls horizontally inside its own box when the panel is na"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"rrower
than the year, is pinned to the current week on first paint, and a hover tooltip names
the da"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"y (`2026-10-27 · 3 条`); a host that still answers the old 84-day window is drawn
as it arrives. The "},{"id":"p17s7","text":"new-versus-updated flow bars below start at the first week with
activity and share one zero line, ea"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"ch carrying the reading
`WW 周 · 新建 n · 更新 m`; then the tag frequency ranking, the type→status compos"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"ition
Sankey (real joint counts: node heights and link bands share one unit-per-note scale,
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Privacy boundary"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Automatic distillation sends text to a model. Here is exactly what crosses that
line."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**What is staged locally.** Completed turns are written to
`$DSH_HOME/data/obsidian-mem/pending/` at"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" mode `0700`/`0600` *before* any model
call, so a restart can resume without calling the model again"},{"id":"p20s3","text":". Raw transcripts are
never written into the vault."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**What is sent.** A whitelist projection of a committed turn: real user messages,
final assistant te"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"xt, tool names with a success/failure flag, and bounded file
paths with line numbers. Plugin injecti"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ons, reasoning blocks, raw tool output,
tool arguments, subagent transcripts, the credential store, "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"credential files and
environment variables are never read into it."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**What is scrubbed.** A deterministic scan skips any message matching a common
credential shape (com"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"mon API-key prefixes, PEM blocks, and similar). A hit skips
the **whole message**, and the receipt r"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"s, PEM blocks, and similar). A hit skips
the **whole message**, and the receipt records that it did."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**What is not guaranteed.** That scan is not an exhaustive secret scanner. If you
paste a secret int"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"o a session in an unrecognised format, the text of that message
is a normal part of the turn and may"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" reach the model route. Treat the session as
you would any conversation with a model provider."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**Where it goes.** Only to the LLM route you configure, or to the session's last
recorded route when"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" `distill.provider`/`model` are empty. Resolving no route is a
`deferred` state, not a call with def"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ault settings. There is no telemetry and no
other network egress."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**What is on disk.** The vault and the pending queue are plain local files, so
whatever backs them u"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"p or syncs them — Git, Time Machine, Obsidian Sync, a cloud
folder — will see them. If that matters "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"for a user message, do not let it be
captured."}],"truncated":true}
